correctness.rationale: Directly reconstructed the 27-vertex graph and the combinatorial Alexander dual as all subsets whose three-subsets induce connected graphs. Exhaustive face vector (27,351,351,81), no five-faces, and an independent coordinate-square argument establish the finite domain. The packaged CHECK.py verifies the signed integer chain condition and exact unimodular unit-pivot boundary reductions of ranks 217 and 81, each with zero residual, showing primitive image lattices and no torsion. Root-edge elimination gives H1(dual)=Z^108 and H2(dual)=Z^53; integral Alexander duality converts to cut homology in dimensions 23 and 22. Pure facet dimension 23 and nonzero H22 prove nonshellability. No unproved homotopy or parameter-uniform extension is asserted.

value.rationale: The three-coordinate ternary Hamming graph is the smallest nonbinary three-factor Hamming graph and a canonical symmetric contrast to established binary-cube and two-factor rook ordinary-cut examples. The dual is a nontrivial 27-vertex 3-complex with 81 tetrahedral relations, so its integral homology cannot be read off from graph cycle rank or simplex counts alone. The two precise torsion-free adjacent-degree groups detect a natural non-shellability obstruction and supply a reproducible benchmark in the theory of cut complexes without requiring a speculative broader theorem.
